name: pincushion
description: View, claim, implement, and resolve stakeholder feedback pins directly in your IDE. Installs the Pincushion MCP server and adds slash commands for setup, viewing pins, brand-aware AI critique on any page (/critique), implementing approved feedback (/implement), and recompiling the project's brand brief (/refresh-brand). All AI work runs locally on your agent's tokens — no Pincushion-side LLM compute.
